description: Agent App blueprint: FastAPI backend with a native Python A2App adapter (the served surface and pure rules in Python). NOT part of the framework.

gate.name: python syntax + adapter self-test
gate.run: python -m py_compile a2app_adapter.py main.py schema.py && python a2app_adapter.py --selftest

gate.name: operations resolve (every declared op has a runner)
gate.run: python -c "import schema,sys; missing=[o['name'] for o in schema.OPERATIONS if o['name'] not in schema.OPERATION_RUNNERS]; sys.exit('declared with no runner: '+', '.join(missing)) if missing else print('operations resolve ok')"
